test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Sustainable Development Goals is highlighted as needing targeted efforts due to its score being below 50?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goal 5 (Gender Equality)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Goal 5 of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) aims to achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.
 
• This goal focuses on ending all forms of discrimination against women and girls everywhere.
 
• It also includes eliminating all forms of violence against women, such as trafficking and sexual exploitation.
 
• Ensuring equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic, and public life is also a part of this goal.
 
• Providing universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights is another target of Goal 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Goal 15 (Life on Land)**

 
 
• This goal aims to protect, restore, and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems.
 
• It includes managing forests sustainably, combating desertification, and halting and reversing land degradation and biodiversity loss.
 
 
 
• **Goal 13 (Climate Action)**
 
 
• This goal focuses on taking urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
 
• It involves integrating climate change measures into national policies, strategies, and planning.
 
 
 
• **Goal 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth)**
 
 
• This goal aims to promote sustained, inclusive, and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment, and decent work for all.
 
• It includes targets such as achieving higher levels of economic productivity and promoting development-oriented policies.
